justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassLoadingStrategy.java:567-598 and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassLoadingStrategyForBootstrapInjectionTest.java. The class has limited fan-out: one constructor with two fields (Instrumentation, File) and one load method that branches only between ClassInjector.UsingInstrumentation and ClassInjector.UsingReflection before delegating to inject(). Fan-in is also low: rg found only two direct instantiations, both in the single test class above, and no other production references. This is not strong hub-like modularization evidence.
